summary: (22 ตุลาคม 2569) เวลา 12.30 น. ณ ศาลาบำเพ็ญ วัดโบราณสถิต ตำบลสุไหงปาดี อำเภอสุไหงปาดี จังหวัดนราธิวาส นายจรัส บำรุงเสนา ผู้ช่วยเลขาธิการ ศอ.บต. title_en: SBPAC attends cremation of D.Lt. Sarojhin Hodnul, who died in the Si Sakhon clashes and confirms that it will continue to take care of the family's rights
summary_en: The 51-year-old policeman Zaroen Hodnul, who died in a clash with the terrorist group, was cremated at 12.30 p.m. on October 22, 2569, by Mr. Jaras Bapsana, Assistant Secretary of SBPAC (Public Relations Department), and staff from SBPAC Relief Group, at the Funeral Hall of Phonom Satit Temple, Su-ngai Padi Village, Su-gai Padi District, Narathiwat Province.
